subject.title: feat: ask_user — structured questions from the agent with web card, channel buttons, and text answers

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `question.*`, `operator.questions`, and `plugin-sdk/question-gateway-runtime` as the permanent provider-neutral contract for agent questions across core and bundled channels?
rationale: This is a new Gateway, authorization, agent-tool, and public plugin SDK surface; implementation quality cannot decide whether that contract should be permanent or initially narrower.

options.title: Approve the core contract
options.body: Keep the provider-neutral RPC, scope, and narrow SDK resolver, subject to native-channel proof and green required checks.

options.title: Land a narrower first slice
options.body: Restrict the initial landing to Gateway, agent, and Control UI behavior, deferring public SDK and native-channel callbacks until the contract is proven.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Do not add the new core protocol until a smaller existing surface can satisfy the same user need.

recommendation.title: Approve the core contract
recommendation.body: Keep the provider-neutral RPC, scope, and narrow SDK resolver, subject to native-channel proof and green required checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The immediately preceding merged question feature explicitly assigned this provider-neutral runtime to a later slice and provides the strongest available product-history signal.
